# Commands

Every heraut command, from the same text as `heraut <command> --help`.

- [heraut](heraut.md): Release management for git-based projects
  - [heraut changelog](heraut_changelog.md): Generate changelog (optionally commit and tag)
  - [heraut check](heraut_check.md): Run preflight validations
    - [heraut check config](heraut_check_config.md): Validate .heraut.yml (offline)
    - [heraut check runtime](heraut_check_runtime.md): Check git, its identity, the history and each release target's token
  - [heraut commit](heraut_commit.md): Commit message tooling
    - [heraut commit check](heraut_commit_check.md): Validate every commit in a range (or full history) against the conventional-commit grammar
    - [heraut commit create](heraut_commit_create.md): Interactively author a Conventional Commits message and commit it
    - [heraut commit tickets](heraut_commit_tickets.md): Validate commits.tickets patterns against a range (or full history) of commits
    - [heraut commit verify](heraut_commit_verify.md): Validate a commit message against the conventional-commit grammar
  - [heraut init](heraut_init.md): Generate .heraut.yml interactively (or with --defaults)
  - [heraut notes](heraut_notes.md): Print the release notes of a tag
  - [heraut release](heraut_release.md): Resolve next version, generate changelog, tag, and publish
  - [heraut skill](heraut_skill.md): Install or print the agent skill that teaches an AI agent to use heraut
    - [heraut skill install](heraut_skill_install.md): Write the agent skill to \<dir\>/heraut/SKILL.md
    - [heraut skill print](heraut_skill_print.md): Print the agent skill (SKILL.md) to stdout
  - [heraut version](heraut_version.md): Print version information
    - [heraut version current](heraut_version_current.md): Print the latest released tag
    - [heraut version next](heraut_version_next.md): Compute and print the next version without side effects
    - [heraut version sprint](heraut_version_sprint.md): Sprint counter management
      - [heraut version sprint bump](heraut_version_sprint_bump.md): Increment versioning.sprint in .heraut.yml
  - [heraut whatsnew](heraut_whatsnew.md): Show release notes for versions newer than the running build

See also [Exit codes](../exit-codes.md) and [Environment variables](../environment-variables.md).
